faq: Do my PDFs get uploaded?
No. ProperPDF processes every file on your phone or tablet. There is no ProperPDF server that receives your documents.
Does it work without internet?
Yes. Every PDF tool works offline. The on-device AI chat needs a one-time model download on some devices before it works offline.
What's free and what needs Pro?
Scan, merge, split, organize and convert are free. Merge and split add a watermark unless you have Pro, and on Android most free tools do. Compress, sign, fill forms and lock need Pro.
Which devices does it run on?
iPhone and iPad with iOS 17 or later, and Android phones and tablets with Android 8.0 or later.

pricing.renew_note: Subscriptions renew through your Apple or Google account until you cancel.
faq: Is ProperPDF free?

Yes, the app is free to download on the App Store and Google Play. Scan, merge, split, organize and convert are free. Some free exports carry a ProperPDF watermark. Compress, sign, fill forms and lock need Pro.
How much does ProperPDF Pro cost?

In the US: $1.99 a week, $3.99 a month, $19.99 a year, or $29.99 once for lifetime access. ProperPDF uses regional pricing, so it costs less in many countries; the store shows your local price before you buy.
Is there a one-time purchase?
Yes. Lifetime Pro is a single payment of $29.99 in the US, about a year and a half of the yearly plan, and less in many countries. There is no subscription to cancel.
Does ProperPDF have ads?
No. The free version adds a watermark to files saved with some tools instead of showing ads.
Do I need an account?
No. ProperPDF doesn't have accounts. Purchases go through your Apple or Google account.

merge-pdf.title: Merge PDFs on iPhone and Android without uploading
merge-pdf.description: Combine PDF files into one on iPhone, iPad or Android. ProperPDF merges them on your phone, offline, with no account. Free to use.
merge-pdf.lead: Pick the files, set the order, save one PDF. Nothing leaves your phone.
merge-pdf.answer: To merge PDFs on your phone without uploading them, open Merge PDF in ProperPDF, pick two or more files, drag them into the order you want and save. The app joins them on the device, so it works offline and you don't need an account. Merging is free on iPhone, iPad and Android. Free exports carry a ProperPDF watermark, which Pro removes.
merge-pdf.steps_title: How to merge PDFs in ProperPDF
steps: Open ProperPDF and tap Merge PDF.
Select two or more PDFs.
Long-press a file and drag it to change the merge order.
Save. The merged PDF appears in your library and the original files stay as they were.
Open the result to check it, then share it from the share sheet.
sections: When merging helps
A contract with its attachments, a visa application with its supporting documents, a month of receipts: one PDF is easier to send and easier to find later than five separate files.
Merging copies the pages as they are. It doesn't re-compress them, so text and scans look the same as in the originals.
After you merge
Use Organize Pages to reorder, rotate or delete pages in the merged file. If it's too big for email, Compress PDF (Pro) saves a smaller copy.
faq: Is merging PDFs free in ProperPDF?
Yes, on both iPhone and Android. The saved file gets a ProperPDF watermark unless you have Pro.
Are my PDFs uploaded when I merge them?
No. ProperPDF merges the files on your phone and doesn't send them to a server, so it also works in airplane mode.
Does merging lower the quality of my PDF?
No. The pages are copied into the new file without being re-compressed.
Can I merge PDFs on iPhone without an app?
On iOS 26 and later, yes: Apple's Preview app can insert pages from another PDF. See our guide to merging PDFs on iPhone without an app.

split-pdf.title: Split a PDF on iPhone and Android without uploading
split-pdf.description: Extract pages from a PDF on iPhone, iPad or Android. Split by page range or every few pages, offline, with no account. Free to use.
split-pdf.lead: Keep the pages you need as a new PDF. The original stays untouched.
split-pdf.answer: To split a PDF on your phone, open Split PDF in ProperPDF, choose the document, then enter a page range or split it every few pages. The app saves the extracted pages as a new PDF and leaves the original as it was. It runs offline on iPhone, iPad and Android, and it's free. Free exports carry a ProperPDF watermark, which Pro removes.
split-pdf.steps_title: How to split a PDF in ProperPDF
steps: Open ProperPDF and tap Split PDF.
Select the PDF you want to split.
Choose how to split it: a range (for example pages 3 to 7) or an interval (a new file every N pages). On Android you can also tick individual pages.
Save. The new PDF appears in your library and the original stays available.
sections: Share only the pages that matter

A long PDF often holds more than the person receiving it needs: one chapter of a report, the signed pages of a contract, a single bank statement out of a year. Sending only those pages keeps the file small and keeps the rest private.
Need to rearrange instead?
Use Organize Pages to drag pages into a different order, rotate them or delete them. Use Merge PDF to bring pages from separate files together.
faq: Can I extract a single page from a PDF?
Yes. Enter the same page as the start and end of the range, and ProperPDF saves that page as its own PDF.
Does splitting change the original PDF?
No. ProperPDF writes the extracted pages to a new file.
Is splitting free?
Yes, on iPhone and Android. Without Pro the saved file has a ProperPDF watermark.

compress-pdf.title: Compress a PDF on iPhone and Android without uploading
compress-pdf.description: Reduce PDF file size on iPhone, iPad or Android. ProperPDF compresses on the device, offline, so the document is never uploaded.
compress-pdf.lead: Make a large PDF small enough to email, without sending it to an online compressor.
compress-pdf.answer: ProperPDF compresses PDFs on the phone itself: pick the file, lower the image resolution, check the estimated size and save a smaller copy. Nothing is uploaded, so it works offline. Compression is a Pro feature on iPhone, iPad and Android. It shrinks scanned and photo-heavy PDFs the most. A PDF that is mostly text may barely change, because text is already compact.
compress-pdf.steps_title: How to compress a PDF in ProperPDF
steps: Open ProperPDF and tap Compress PDF.
Select the PDF.
Move the image resolution slider. Lower means a smaller file and softer images. The app shows the current size and an estimate of the new one.
Save. ProperPDF writes a new, smaller copy and keeps the original.
Open the copy and zoom in on small text and signatures before you send it.
sections: Why compress on the device

Online compressors have to receive your file before they can shrink it. That is fine for a flyer, less fine for a payslip, a medical letter or a signed contract. ProperPDF does the same job without the upload.
Getting a smaller file

Scans and photo-heavy PDFs shrink the most; a 20-page text export from Word has very little to give. If the file is still too big, split off or delete the pages the recipient doesn't need, which cuts size without touching quality.

On iPhone, compression currently turns each page into an image. Text in the copy can no longer be selected or searched, and form fields, links and annotations are removed, so keep the original if you need those. On Android, only the images inside the PDF are shrunk.
faq: Is PDF compression free in ProperPDF?
No. Compress PDF is part of Pro on both iPhone and Android.
How much smaller will my PDF get?
It depends on the file. Scans and photo-heavy PDFs often shrink a lot; text-only PDFs may hardly change. The app shows an estimated size before you save.
Will compression make my PDF blurry?
Lower resolutions soften images and scanned text. Save, zoom in on the smallest text, and pick a higher setting if it's hard to read.
Will I still be able to select text after compressing?
On Android, yes. On iPhone, compression currently turns pages into images, so text can't be selected and form fields and links are removed. ProperPDF keeps your original file.

sign-pdf.title: Sign a PDF on your phone without uploading it
sign-pdf.description: Draw your signature and place it on a PDF on iPhone, iPad or Android. ProperPDF signs documents offline, with no account.
sign-pdf.lead: Sign a form or agreement on your phone without sending it to an e-signature website.
sign-pdf.answer: To sign a PDF on your phone, open Sign PDF in ProperPDF, choose the document, draw your signature with your finger (or pick one you saved before), place it on the page, resize it and save. Signing happens on the device, offline and without an account. It's a Pro tool on iPhone, iPad and Android. This adds a drawn signature to the page; it isn't a certificate-based digital signature.
sign-pdf.steps_title: How to sign a PDF in ProperPDF
steps: Open ProperPDF and tap Sign PDF.
Select the document.
Draw your signature, or choose a saved one.
Tap the page where it belongs, then move and resize it.
Save a signed copy and check every page before sending.
sections: Drawn signature vs digital signature

ProperPDF places an image of your handwritten signature on the page, which is what most forms, leases and permission slips ask for. Some legal and government processes need a certificate-based digital signature instead, which tools like Foxit PDF Editor's paid plan create. ProperPDF doesn't.
Fill first, then sign
If the document is a form, complete the fields with Fill PDF first, then add your signature.
faq: Is signing a PDF free in ProperPDF?
No. Sign PDF is a Pro tool on both iPhone and Android.
Can I reuse my signature?
Yes. On iPhone you can pick a signature you created earlier instead of drawing it again.
Is my signature uploaded?
No. The signature and the document stay on your phone.
sign-pdf.mockup_caption: The Sign PDF screen in ProperPDF for iPhone. The Android screen looks different.

image-to-pdf.title: Turn photos into a PDF on your phone
image-to-pdf.description: Combine photos, screenshots and scans into one PDF on iPhone, iPad or Android with ProperPDF, offline. Free to use.
image-to-pdf.lead: Turn a handful of photos or screenshots into one PDF.
image-to-pdf.answer: To turn photos into a PDF, open Image to PDF in ProperPDF, select the images, put them in order and save. Each image becomes a page and the PDF is created on the device, offline. It's free on iPhone and iPad, and free on Android with a ProperPDF watermark that Pro removes.
image-to-pdf.steps_title: How to make a PDF from images
steps: Open ProperPDF and tap Image to PDF.
Select the photos or screenshots.
Arrange the pages in the order you want.
Save, then open the PDF to check it.
sections: Useful for everyday paperwork
Receipts for an expense claim, photos of a whiteboard, screenshots of a booking, pages of handwritten notes. One PDF is easier to send than twelve photos.
If the PDF is large
Phone photos are big, so a PDF made from them can be too. Compress PDF (Pro) makes a smaller copy.
faq: Is Image to PDF free?
Yes. On Android the PDF carries a ProperPDF watermark unless you have Pro.
Are my photos uploaded?
No. ProperPDF builds the PDF on your phone.
